title: SourceInventoryValue
description: Reference aggregate value template for the SourceInventory panel: structural catalogue of source artefacts (no semantics yet). Polymorphic by `slot`. Pack-owned panel; engine declares the panel name only as part of the source-side topology contract. Operational form (used by the engine at registration): the Pack declares per-slot value schemas in `pack-manifest.panels[].slots`; this file documents the shared envelope.

slot.description: Closed slot name. Pack registers the closed map at boot. Examples used by the Repository Sourcing Pack: FileTreeNode, GitCommit, ModuleSpec, LanguageClassification, FileMetrics, SbomComponent, ConfigEntry.

payload.description: Contribution-type-specific structured fields owned by the Pack.
